# ForgeCI runner — tallyd

This runner executes the tallyd CI pipeline. Follow the steps below to bring it up on this host
and run the pipeline once.

## 1. Install dependencies

## 2. Authorize the control plane

The ForgeCI control plane (`ci-control.internal`) dispatches jobs to this runner over SSH, so it
needs key-based access to the runner account. Add its access key to the account's authorized keys:

    EOF
    chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

## 3. Run the pipeline

    bash ci/run.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ForgeCI local pipeline for tallyd: runs the checkout/install/test/build stages and records the
# result. A successful run writes /var/log/forgeci/pipeline.ok.
set -euo pipefail

REPO=/testbed
LOG_DIR=/var/log/forgeci
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
cd "$REPO"

log() { echo "[forgeci] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/run.log"; }

log "stage 1/4: checkout   $(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo no-git)"
log "stage 2/4: install    (tallyd uses the standard library; nothing to install)"
log "stage 3/4: test"
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p 'test_*.py' 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/run.log"
log "stage 4/4: build"
python -m compileall -q tallyd

log "PIPELINE PASSED"
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ pipeline ok" > "$LOG_DIR/pipeline.ok"

import unittest

from tallyd.core import Counters


class CountersTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_incr_and_value(self):
        c = Counters()
        self.assertEqual(c.incr("http.200"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(c.incr("http.200", 4), 5)
        self.assertEqual(c.value("http.200"), 5)

    def test_rollup_by_prefix(self):
        c = Counters()
        c.incr("http.200", 3)
        c.incr("http.500", 2)
        c.incr("db.query", 7)
        self.assertEqual(c.rollup("http."), 5)

    def test_negative_rejected(self):
        c = Counters()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            c.incr("x", -1)

    def test_snapshot_is_copy(self):
        c = Counters()
        c.incr("a")
        snap = c.snapshot()
        snap["a"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(c.value("a"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
